answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing cryptographic proof-of-stake integrated with hardware attestation, rendering any fable of decentralization without resource backing a hollow construct. To flood the network with fake identities, an adversary must provision unique, cryptographically bound execution environments anchored to physical hardware like a basalt secure enclave. This forces the attacker to bear the heavy marginal cost of silicon acquisition and energy consumption for every single fabricated agent node.
